title: BeerSmith Efficiency Drop vs Recipe Baseline
dataSources: Fermentation gravity/temperature (`brew:fermentation`), kegerator pours (`kegerator:pour`), wine-cellar climate (`winecellar:reading`).
app: Fermentation sensors (Tilt/iSpindel hydrometer, temperature), kegerator flow meters and scales, and wine-cellar climate sensors via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=beersmith:batch
stats avg(efficiency_pct) as eff by recipe_name
where eff<recipe_baseline*0.9
description: Compares BeerSmith brewhouse efficiency to recipe baseline.
value: Surfacing beersmith efficiency drop vs recipe baseline helps you act before small issues become habits.
implementation: Ingest the relevant homebrewing, beer & wine export into `index=personal` and schedule this search weekly.
visualization: Table or chart of key fields.
grandmaExplanation: It builds when beersmith efficiency drop vs recipe baseline matters for your routine.
